title: Surface Scanner Lab
objectives: Tell regular reflection from diffused reflection
Match surfaces to the kind of reflection they give
Explain how reflected light can reflect again

stages.title: The Vault of Surfaces
stages.narration: Scan each surface, Sleuth — the right reflection reveals shard 3.

steps.text: Shard 3 hides in a vault of strange surfaces.
Anaya: 'Why does the mirror show my face but the wall doesn't?'
Ray Bot hands you the Surface Scanner.

stages.title: Which Reflection?
stages.prompt: Sort each surface by the kind of reflection it gives.
stages.note: Smooth surfaces keep rays parallel (regular); rough surfaces scatter them (diffused). Both obey i = r!

stages.title: Spot the Diffused Reflectors
stages.prompt: Tap every surface that gives DIFFUSED (scattered) reflection.

feedback.correct: Right! This rough surface scatters light in all directions.
feedback.incorrect: This is smooth — it gives regular reflection and a clear image.

stages.title: Mini-Boss: Bounce to the Shard
stages.prompt: Score 80% to steer light off two mirrors and grab shard 3!

questions.q: A wall does not show a reflection because it gives…
questions.explain: The rough wall scatters light (diffused), so no clear image forms.

questions.q: On a smooth mirror, parallel rays reflect as…
questions.explain: Regular reflection keeps parallel rays parallel, forming a clear image.

questions.q: In diffused reflection the laws of reflection are…
questions.explain: Each point still obeys i = r; the surface is just uneven.

questions.q: Can reflected light be reflected again?
questions.explain: Light can bounce off mirror after mirror, each time obeying the laws.

questions.q: We can see a non-luminous object from many angles because of…
questions.explain: Scattered light reaches our eyes from any direction, so we see the object all around.

stages.title: Crystal Shard 3 Recovered!
messages: 🏅 You earned the Surface Sleuth badge
You scanned every surface like a true detective!
